notes.title: Playtest update p1.0.26
notes.notes:
The Playtest build has been updated to version p1.0.26.

New Additions

 Heist 04 - A new set of combat encounters has been added. The enemies are similar to those in H01 but come with a slightly different set of cards, and their stats are scaled up to offer more of a challenge.
 Heist 05 - A new set of combat encounters featuring a new enemy type that introduces the Burn status effect.


Added the modifications for the two cards that were missing them:

notes.title: Playtest update p1.0.25
notes.notes:
Changes

 Upgrades have been renamed to Modifications, and the system has been permanently changed into a reversible action. Once you unlock a modification, you can always revert it to the base version or select a different modification. This can allow for more experimentation and prevent locking the player into a choice they initially thought was good, but turned out it didn't suit their playstyle.

Fixes

 Fixed a small issue in combat tutorial.
 Fixed an issue with sorting of cards when you inspected your deck in combat.
 Added PS controller icons.

Rebalancing

 Reduced the healing on Focus Body and Flowing Renewal from 2 → 1. These were always meant to provide incidental healing, and it became clear that healing 2 HP for 0, especially when cycling through your deck, was just too strong.

notes.title: Playtest update p1.0.24
notes.notes:
Card preview in deck list in deck editor

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/160b1d375546acd1bec463caa834aec721544b13.png

 A highly requested feature of the deck editor - when you hover over a card in your deck list, it will now show a miniature of the card

Card Rebalancing
A number of cards have been rebalanced, with the main goal of reducing the card advantage some provided and decreasing the likelihood and consistency of infinite combos. 

Many of the 'card advantage' effects have been replaced with 'card selection' effects. While this still allows for satisfying combos, it should also reduce the consistency of infinite loops, as most cards now only replace themselves.

Some cards have also been adjusted so that they no longer draw a card immediately; instead, a combo condition must be triggered first.

 Powerful Slash - Now draws a card only in combo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/84b0911894dcfae6f75425144637554b4fa45924.png

 Reliable Follow Through - Now draws a card only in combo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/bc8ca8dbd8542db3dbe7167a21047527695c4c3a.png

 Furious Uppercut - Now draws a card only in combo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/e199ae9a9a516a060042b1186a19931a5fc2fbc8.png

 Focus Mind - This card was initially doing too much—triggering a combo with Preparation, its most reliable partner in crime, while also replacing itself and ramping you up. It has now been changed to a rummage effect (discard -> draw), which can still improve deck consistency but is much more balanced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/aadf9cb43e8cfafe675048a25f371fe974f17bfd.png

 Flowing Opportunity - This card is a twin to Focus, so the same reasoning was applied here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/68520885dad746e0267dc6372fee59522d4dfe74.png

 Preparation - The card advantage this card offered turned out to be just a bit too much. Its base version and both upgrades have been adjusted to provide powerful card selection instead. (The upgrades switched names to fit the effect of the cards better)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/1da9ff0adc311a72af4de41c75d419f4cc0468f3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/50a1560ac32efe8b17ef8552bb3145fb6a926933.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/62a6101509075481d9ea8ac05fba8a4bdd5a2681.png

 One More Time - The base version of the card was missing a distinctive identity and sometimes was straight up undesirable to play it. I decided to add a dual combo (formerly used only on one of the Big Finisher upgrades), to make it stand out a bit more and also make it slightly stronger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/8300f7a1e10ca412858ac359b54eb61151d3b139.png

 One Last Time - This card was simply too strong and served as the backbone of a potential infinite loop, drawing three cards with virtually no cost. The nerfed version is still powerful, but I believe it’s now more balanced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/35140dad6873e335f42bd9b3d15b1ad65729c801.png

 One More Dance - Since the former effect of this card was transferred to the new version of One Last Time, I wanted to find an effect that felt dynamic and multifaceted, something that could metaphorically evoke a dance-like feeling (?).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/e64a6545765356e534309f83e2811f730ee06b1b.png

 Tempest of Steel (replacing Hurricane of Steel) - I obviously underestimated the number of cards you can potentially play in one turn. As a result, this card was often too powerful and a bit dull, as it simply dealt an excessive amount of damage. While the base version of Storm of Steel is inspired by the most iconic Storm payoff from Magic: The Gathering, this upgraded version pays tribute to the second most popular one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073221/ce63436830501f5aeb0129cada19370c312e564d.png



That's all for now folks, see you next week with a next update.

For more info or if you want to give is direct feedback about the playtest, consider joining our Discord.

notes.title: Playtest update p1.0.23
notes.notes:
Changes to playtest card collection

 From now on, you'll start with only the default deck in your card collection.
 Moved the remaining cards to the Black Market. This change prevents your collection from getting bloated with cards you’re not planning to use during a particular test. It also allows for a playthrough that more closely mimics the actual progression in the game. (Note: Buying cards add them to your collection, not to your deck.)
 It is now possible to upgrade or revert card upgrades from the Deck Editor at any time. This feature is currently available for testing purposes only.

Fixes

 Fixed an error in our Steam configuration that was preventing players (who weren’t directly provided with game keys) from downloading the game.
 Added missing eurocred glyph to the prices in Black Market
 Fixed Quick Patch-Up - its combo effect was healing only 3 HP, even though it should have been healing 4 HP.
 Fixed missing description in the hub tooltip on the world map.


For more info or if you want to give is direct feedback about the playtest, consider joining our Discord.

notes.title: Playtest update p1.0.20
notes.notes:
Alex Cards Rebalancing

 Careful Planing - Lowered AP cost from 2 -> 1
 Monowire - Added Ignore Shield and lowered the AP cost from 2 -> 1.
 Proper Patch-up (patch up U2) - Lowered AP cost from 2 -> 1.
 Throwing Blades - Combo also gives 1 AP. (BEFORE: COMBO A: Draw a card. // NOW: COMBO A: Gain 1 AP and draw a card.)
 Fury Blades (formerly Throwing Blades U2) - Lowered AP cost from 1 -> 0.
 Adrenaline Surge - Added the Remove keyword.
 Toxic Healing - Increased healing from 6 -> 8.
 Noxious Healing - Increased healing from 6 -> 8.
 Adrenaline Healing (formerly Tainted Healing) - Increased healing and toxic, now the card also adds haste (BEFORE: Heal 4 HP to self and gain Toxic 1. COMBO B: Only heal 4 HP to self instead. // NOW: Heal 8 HP to self and gain Toxic 2. COMBO B: Also gain Haste 1.)
 Upgrade - Stronger base effect (BEFORE: Gain 2 Shield and Haste 2. Draw 2 cards then discard 2 cards. // NOW: Gain 3 Shield and Haste 3. Draw 3 cards.)
 Optimization (formerly Upgrade U1) - Stronger base and combo effect (BEFORE: Gain 2 Shield and Haste 2. Draw 2 cards then discard 2 cards. Combo B: Reduce the cost by 1 AP. // NOW: Gain 2 Shield and Haste 2. Draw 2 cards. Combo B: Reduce the cost by 2 AP.)
 Augmentation (formerly Upgrade U2) - Stronger base effect (BEFORE: Gain 3 Shield and Haste 3. Draw 3 cards then discard 3 cards. // NOW: Gain 4 Shield and Haste 4. Draw 4 cards.)
 Thorough Scavenge (formerly Scavenge U1) - Lower AP cost and lower damage and heal (BEFORE: 2AP - Deal 5 Damage. If it eliminates the enemy heal 5 HP to self. // NOW: 1 AP - Deal 4 Damage. If it eliminates the enemy heal 4 HP to self.)
 Swift Scavenge (formerly Scavenge U2) - Increase to damage and healing (BEFORE: 0AP - Deal 2 Damage. If it eliminates the enemy heal 2 HP to self. // NOW: 0AP - Deal 3 Damage. If it eliminates the enemy heal 3 HP to self.)
 Shadow Slash (formerly Ninja Slash U1) - Increased damage. (BEFORE: Deal 3 damage. // NOW: Deal 4 damage.)
 Phantom Slash (formerly Ninja Slash U2) - Increased damage. (BEFORE: Deal 3 damage. // NOW: Deal 4 damage.)
 Shadow Backstab (formerly Venomous Backstab a.k.a Backstab U2) - Changed the combo effect (BEFORE: If you have Stealth, deal 8 damage instead and give Toxic 2. // NOW: If you have Stealth, deal 8 damage instead and gain Stealth.)
 Brewing Storm of Steel (Storm of Steel U2) - Lowered AP cost from 2 -> 1.
 Become Vengeance (Become Invisible U2) - Increased Payback from 3 -> 4.

Switch up card types

 Backstab - Formerly A now C card
 Shuriken - Formerly A now C card
 Snakebite - Formerly A now C card
 Toxic Healing - Formerly C now A card
 Neurotoxin - Formerly C now A card

Misc

 Added music to the hub
 Added full World Map
 Fixed tooltip captions of World Map nodes
 Proper subtitle in main menu

Visual

 Replaced multiple placeholder images on enemy cards with actual images

Fixes

 Deck persistence in save file
 Choice / Dialogue prerequisite translations
 Bug when drawing cards when all cards are in hand
